answer: A proposed market rejects earning keys without a current-round credential from synchronized 15-minute in-person ceremonies; each extra alias costs 1 additional attendee for that interval. Staff monitor continuous attendance and issue one key-bound credential per person; a shared registry rejects reused serials. Whether tending a terrace or planning a voyage, an agent cannot earn with an echo of another key. Surprise inspections and venue revocation deter forged attendance. Honest registrars and a common session window are required; hired people and colluding venues remain risks.
